title: Coefficient-exact triangles for cones of regular-immersion classes
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a regular closed immersion $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ of Noetherian schemes with $\ell$ invertible, of constant codimension $c\geq0$. Regular means locally cut out by a regular sequence [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]. For $r\geq1$ put $A_r=\mathbf Z/\ell^r\mathbf Z$ and let $\eta_r:A_{r,Z}\to i_r^!A_{r,X}(c)[2c]$ be the supported Kummer class of [lem-per-regular-immersion-class-calculus]. On ordinary etale derived categories with Tate twists [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-asd-finite-etale-tate-twist], one can choose cones $C_r$ of the actual maps $\eta_r$ so that for every $a,b\geq1$ there is a distinguished triangle
$$C_a\longrightarrow C_{a+b}\longrightarrow C_b\longrightarrow C_a[1]$$
in $D^+(Z_{\mathrm{et}},A_{a+b})$, with the outer complexes viewed there by restriction of scalars. These triangles are induced by the coefficient sequence $0\to A_a\xrightarrow{\ell^b}A_{a+b}\to A_b\to0$ and its corresponding sequence of Tate lines. Cones and distinguished triangles have their usual derived meaning [def-weil-triangulated-category]; the cohomology sheaves of each $C_r$ are bounded below.
